news.title: ‘It was terrifying.’ Teen shot dead near Halloween house party
news.summary: An unidentified 18-year-old man was shot and killed outside a Halloween house party early Sunday morning in northwest Atlanta.

news.title: Atlanta airline worker arrested in child exploitation probe
news.summary: Deputies arrested an Atlanta airline worker in the driveway of his Coweta County home late last week after a national tip sparked an online child exploitation investigation, officials said.

news.title: ‘My favorite person in the world:’ Father remembers 7-year-old killed in Cobb County crash
news.summary: A father is turning pain into purpose after his daughter was killed in a crash in Cobb County.

news.title: 15-year-old accused of murder in Cobb shooting on Mustang Drive
news.summary: A 15-year-old faces a murder charge as an adult after police said he shot and killed 18-year-old British Hart late Friday night in Powder Springs.

news.title: Victim identified in targeted shooting at Roswell apartments
news.summary: A man has died after gunfire erupted at a Roswell apartment complex late Saturday night, prompting a homicide investigation.

news.title: Warrant: Suspect fired into crowd outside Downtown Atlanta nightclub, hit victim seven times
news.summary: Arrest warrants for the suspect in a shooting outside Lyfe ATL around 1:30 a.m. Sunday morning do not make clear what the motivation may have been.

news.title: Someone knows her: Investigators seek name of woman found inside toolbox in Duluth
news.summary: Duluth Police and the Gwinnett County Medical Examiner's Office aren’t giving up on identifying a woman found inside a toolbox in 2023.

news.title: Former High Museum of Art exec gets 1 year in federal prison for stealing $600K from museum
news.summary: A sentence for Brady Lum, formerly the chief operating officer at Atlanta's High Museum of Art, was announced by federal prosecutors on Monday.

news.title: Roswell PD identifies man killed in shooting believed to be targeted
news.summary: Roswell Police first reported the shooting on Saturday night.

news.title: 15-year-old arrested and charged with murder in shooting of Powder Springs 18-year-old
news.summary: The victim has been identified as 18-year-old British Hart.

news.title: Deadly shooting Monday in DeKalb County under investigation
news.summary: An adult victim died after being shot on Springfair Run, DeKalb County police said.

news.title: Shooter in Memorial Drive incident on Oct. 20 sought by police
news.summary: A 45-year-old man was shot near 234 Memorial Drive on Oct. 20 after a verbal altercation escalated to gunfire, police said.

news.title: Two DeKalb officers still in stable condition after being shot in line of duty, GBI says; suspect remains in custody in hospital
news.summary: A 26-year-old suspect was taken into custody by assisting Atlanta Police officers on Sunday night after a shooting at an apartment complex.

news.title: Critical Missing update: 12-year-old reported missing in Atlanta found
news.summary: Atlanta police asked early Monday morning for help to locate a "critical missing" 12-year-old male. A few hours later, police say he was found and is in "good health."
